chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Barqi, from al-Qasim ibn Yahya, from his grandfather al-Hasan ibn Rashid, from Abi al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:
He was asked about the meaning of Allah, so he said: The one who rules over what is lowly and great.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the name Allah according to Imam Musa ibn Ja'far?
ai.summary: Imam Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him) defines the name 'Allah' as referring to the Divine One who possesses dominion and control over all things, both minute and great. This definition emphasizes God's comprehensive sovereignty over the entirety of creation, highlighting the concept of *Al-Ilah* (the Deity) as the one who is worshipped and holds absolute authority over every detail of the universe.

en.ammaar-muslim: 3. [3/389] al-Kafi: A number of our companions from Ahmad b. Muhammad al-Barqi from al-Qasim b. Yahya from his grandfather al-Hasan b. Rashid from Abi al-Hasan Musa b. Ja’far عليه السلام.
He (al-Hasan) said: He (the Imam) was asked about the meaning of Allah so he said: The one who rules over what is lowly and great.
